What this app does with your data

Weight Sync reads one thing from Health Connect: your weight readings. Nothing else.

It sends the latest reading for each day, with the date and whether it came from Samsung Health, to the calorie tracker website you connect it to. That is the only place it sends anything. There are no ads, analytics or third parties.

It identifies itself to your website with a key derived from your sync passphrase on this phone. The passphrase itself is never stored or sent.

To stop, tap Disconnect or remove access in Health Connect. Data already sent stays in your tracker until you delete it there.
